🧺 Laundry Process Redesign – Home Operations Case (OPMT 620)

Course: OPMT 620 – Operations Management
Type: Individual case study • Flow process chart • Lean waste analysis
Tools: Flow process chart, waste analysis, process redesign

Project Snapshot

I analysed my own home laundry routine as if it were a small “operations system.” I documented the current-state process using a flow process chart, tracking every operation, transport, delay, and inspection step, along with the time, distance walked, and cost implications. The original process took 138 minutes and required 670 feet of walking around the house. :contentReferenceoaicite:0

The key wastes I identified were:

  • Excessive transportation (clothes moving between multiple rooms)
  • Waiting time during machine cycles
  • Over-processing and repeated handling (sorting and stain inspection done separately)
  • Inefficient layout and lack of standardization

Improvements & Results

I then designed a future-state process that:

  • Added laundry hampers in each room to reduce trips
  • Combined sorting and stain inspection into a single step
  • Used a wheeled laundry basket and detergent pods
  • Placed the washer and dryer side-by-side with a nearby folding station

These changes cut total cycle time to 75 minutes and reduced walking distance to 305 feet, saving 63 minutes and 365 feet of movement per full laundry cycle, while making the work more ergonomic. :contentReferenceoaicite:1

🤖 UiPath & BMO – Banking Automation Case Study (CMPT 641)

Course: CMPT 641 – Digital Transformation
Type: Individual written assignment • Vendor analysis • Financial services case
Tools: Secondary research, vendor comparison, value chain & benefits analysis

Project Snapshot

For this assignment, I explored how UiPath, a leading robotic process automation (RPA) platform, helps the Bank of Montreal (BMO) modernise operations. I started with a vendor scan, comparing UiPath to competitors such as Microsoft Power Automate, Automation Anywhere, and Blue Prism, and summarised why UiPath holds a leading market share in RPA and strong analyst recognition. :contentReferenceoaicite:2

Problem & Solution

BMO faced:

  • Heavy manual workloads in compliance reporting, transaction monitoring, and testing
  • High operational costs and slower turnaround times
  • Fragmented legacy systems across different jurisdictions

Working with UiPath and Deloitte, BMO built an Automation Centre of Excellence (CoE) and deployed unattended and attended bots for processes like loan origination, KYC/AML checks, and reporting. Bots were orchestrated via UiPath Studio and Orchestrator, integrated with Microsoft 365, Oracle, and internal banking systems. :contentReferenceoaicite:3

Impact

The case highlighted how automation:

  • Delivered millions of dollars in value through labour savings and cost avoidance
  • Achieved 20–60% productivity improvements in some credit and back-office workflows
  • Reduced error rates and improved compliance audit trails
  • Freed employees to focus on more analytical and customer-facing work
